title: Incident Command System flashcards: for the FEMA IS-100.c, IS-200.c, IS-700.b and IS-800.d courses
description: The Incident Command System, NIMS and the National Response Framework for the four FEMA independent study courses, from the course manuals and FEMA doctrine: every idea explained before it is tested.

glossary.ATM: automated teller machine, a cash machine
glossary.GIS: geographic information system, software for maps and location data
glossary.HHS: Department of Health and Human Services
glossary.IS: Independent Study, FEMA's series of free online courses
glossary.NCMEC: National Center for Missing & Exploited Children
glossary.SARA: Superfund Amendments and Reauthorization Act of 1986

sourceShort: the FEMA course manuals, NIMS 2017 and the NRF 2019
notice: IS-100.c, IS-200.c, IS-700.b and IS-800.d are courses of the FEMA Emergency Management Institute (NDEMU). This deck is independent and is not affiliated with, sponsored, endorsed or approved by FEMA, DHS or the Federal Government. Course content is adapted from NDEMU and FEMA publications, which are US Government works in the public domain; NDEMU is the originator of the material.

checks.what: Two independent audits read all 1075 cards against the IS-100.c, IS-200.c and IS-700.b student manuals, NIMS 2017, the NRF 2019 and the National Preparedness Goal, for accuracy and for plain language
checks.result: 15 wrong answers, 45 unsupported claims, 35 ambiguous cards and 11 unclear ones were fixed, with about 150 minor issues including page links. Scenarios that followed course activities too closely were replaced with new ones. Set cards now each ask a question only one member answers. 12 diagrams were drawn from the sources.
